verdict.rationale: Square's Locations API docs say additional locations can be created beyond the default one, and the Terminal API connects a custom POS to a Square Terminal. However, nothing in the pack shows readers or devices being registered or paired to a new location via API, so only the location-creation half of the end-to-end flow is evidenced, and only thinly. missing for 10: explicit create-location API documentation, API-based reader/device registration or pairing to a location, an end-to-end agent provisioning example, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers

citations.quote: Newly created accounts only have this single location, but more locations can be created.
Learn how to use a Square API to update and retrieve location information for a Square seller.
Use the Terminal API to connect a custom POS application with a Square Terminal.
